about_intro: For 14+ years, farmers across India have trusted Jarvi for guava saplings built for real fields, real soil, and real income. Deep red pulp, heavy fruit, premium market price — every season.
about_who_body: Jarvi Seeds & Nursery Pvt. Ltd. is a Gujarat-based nursery specialising in high-yield guava saplings, grown and grafted using our own rootstock technology. We are proud to be India's first NHB (National Horticulture Board) registered nursery in Dragon Fruit.
about_mission_body: To give every farmer — from a half-acre plot to a large commercial orchard — access to saplings that are bred for real field conditions, not just for looking good in a nursery. Higher yield, stronger disease resistance, and a better price at market.
about_reach_body: Grown in Bharadiya, Valia, Bharuch, Gujarat, and delivered across India. 500+ farmers already trust Jarvi saplings for their orchards.
about_quote_1: "A sapling is a promise to a farmer's next three harvests — we don't take that lightly."
about_quote_2: "Grown for the field, not the greenhouse."
about_quote_3: "Fourteen years in, we still test every variety in real soil before it reaches a farmer's cart."
collab_quote: “Great things in farming grow through great partnerships.”
